title: Signal: PostgreSQL connection or authentication error text disclosed in a response

check.valuePattern: (?:pg_query\(\): Query failed|PG::ConnectionBad|FATAL:\s+password authentication failed for user|psql: error: connection to server)

scope: One response body containing a PostgreSQL connection or authentication error string.
limitations: One response body. The check reads the message text; it does not attempt a connection and cannot tell whether the named role still exists.

observation.body: FATAL:  password authentication failed for user "reporting"
Warning: pg_query(): Query failed: server closed the connection unexpectedly
ERROR:  syntax error at or near "SELEC"

fpNotes: A documentation page that quotes the message is reported; a readiness probe returning only a status word is not.
